content.user_title: Build Claude Code Skills and Hooks
content.value_statement: Teams need consistent guidance when creating Claude Code skills, hooks, agents, and commands. This skill provides templates, trigger patterns, and checklists for repeatable setup.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to create domain or guardrail skills.
Shows the expected SKILL.md directory structure.
Documents file, prompt, keyword, and regex trigger patterns.
Lists integration steps for testing skill activation.
Gives troubleshooting guidance for missing or noisy triggers.
limitations: Does not install skills or modify files automatically.
Does not validate JSON against a schema.
Does not include executable helper scripts.
Focuses on Claude Code workflows, not general plugin marketplaces.

use_cases.title: Create Team Skills
use_cases.description: Define a reusable SKILL.md structure and trigger rules for a team workflow.

use_cases.title: Configure Guardrails
use_cases.description: Design block or warn rules that activate for risky project patterns.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Activation
use_cases.description: Check trigger keywords, path patterns, and exclusions when a skill does not appear.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new workflow guide.
prompt_templates.prompt: I need a new Claude Code skill for [workflow]. Draft the SKILL.md sections, frontmatter, and trigger ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Add Trigger Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Design skill-rules.json triggers for [skill name]. Include keyword, intent, path, and exclusion guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Guardrail Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced setup for safety or quality enforcement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a guardrail skill for [risk]. Define enforcement level, priority, activation examples, and testing steps.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Skill Coverage
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of existing skill rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my skill concept and trigger rules. Identify over-triggering risks, missing exclusions, and clearer activation patterns.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for React component standards.
output: A SKILL.md outline with purpose, when to use, design rules, and testing notes.
Suggested trigger keywords for components, pages, styling, and React patterns.
A short checklist for validating activation in real project files.

output_examples.input: Troubleshoot why my skill does not trigger.
output: A review path for path patterns, keyword spelling, intent patterns, and exclusions.
Likely causes ranked by how often they prevent activation.
Concrete changes to make trigger rules more specific.

output_examples.input: Design a guardrail skill for database migrations.
output: Recommended enforcement and priority settings for migration review.
Activation ideas based on file paths, migration terms, and risky operations.
Testing steps to confirm the guardrail appears only when needed.

best_practices: Keep the main skill concise and move detailed guidance into resources.
Use specific triggers that match real project paths and user intent.
Test activation after every change to skill rules.
anti_patterns: Using broad keywords that make the skill appear for unrelated tasks.
Putting long reference material directly in the main SKILL.md file.
Setting block enforcement before the trigger rules are tested.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create Claude Code skills, hooks, agents, slash commands, and activation rules.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides documentation and examples for users to review and apply.

faq.question: Can it help with guardrail skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains block and warn enforcement patterns for quality and safety workflows.

faq.question: Does it include ready-made templates?
faq.answer: It includes structure examples and configuration patterns, but not generated project files.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: Developers, engineering leads, and platform teams who manage Claude Code workflows can use it.

faq.question: Is it only for Claude Code?
faq.answer: The guidance is written for Claude Code. Some planning ideas may also help Codex or Claude users.
